title: Field Snap & Notes
subtitle: Camera Capture, Project Tagging & Instant JSON/CSV Export
description: Quick mobile photo & field note logger using RollupBridge Camera, Isolated Per-User Storage, and Android Share Sheet export.
tagline: Fast Mobile Photo & Field Note Logger • Hardware Camera Compression, Project Tagging & Instant CSV Export

quickstart.step: Set Your Default Project Tag (`⚙️ Settings`)
quickstart.detail: Tap `⚙️ Settings` in the top system strip to configure your default Project / Job Tag (pre-fills automatically on every new note) or type a custom tag per entry.

Tap `📷 Snap / Attach Photo` to launch your Android rear camera. RollupBridge automatically resizes (`1280px` max width) and JPEG-compresses (`82%`) images so hundreds of snaps fit comfortably on device.
Enter a quick field observation and tap `💾 Save Entry`. Entries are stored strictly under your signed-in Google email namespace.
Tap `📤 Export CSV` at the top right to download a clean spreadsheet of timestamps, project tags, notes, and photo flags.

navigation_map.purpose: Project tag input, multi-line field observation box, live camera thumbnail preview, and 1-tap save.
Chronological timeline of your saved photos and notes with per-item delete (`✕`) controls.
1-tap CSV report download, default project configuration, and User Manual PDF access.

deep_dive_features.title: Client-Side Canvas Photo Compression (`RollupBridge.camera`)
deep_dive_features.body: Raw 12MP–50MP phone photos (`5–12 MB` each) would quickly exhaust browser storage quotas. Field Snap compresses captures on-device into crisp `~120–220 KB` JPEGs in milliseconds.

deep_dive_features.title: Zero Cross-User Leakage
deep_dive_features.body: Two technicians signing into the same shared tablet or their own phones each see only their own `rollup::v1::u::<email>::app::field-snap::entries` bucket.

pro_tips: Use consistent project prefixes (e.g., `CSC-26-4182`) so exported CSVs sort and pivot cleanly in Excel.
